arc_of.description: A returned episode ID whose cross-session history should be inspected.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from the preceding page. Omit for the first page.

from.description: Inclusive lower time bound as Unix milliseconds, not seconds. Omit for no lower bound.

id.description: An existing returned item identifier for this operation.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Omit for the server default; request only the amount of context needed.

session_id.description: An existing host session reference. Omit unless a session-specific operation requires it; verified host identity takes precedence.

similar_to.description: A natural-language situation to compare with earlier episodes.

until.description: Upper time bound as Unix milliseconds, not seconds. Omit for no upper bound.
